csv_project_name: Developer for Blue Heron Nature Preserve Redevelopment
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Atlanta, on behalf of the Department of Parks and Recreation (DPR), will shortly undergo a Request for Proposals (RFP) process toward the procurement of a qualified Developer/Operator team to support the redevelopment of the Blue Heron Nature Preserve. The selected team will be responsible for the design, financing, construction, and long-term operation of a new purpose-built nature center that enhances environmental education, community engagement, and natural resource stewardship. Interested vendors will be evaluated on whether they meet the minimum technical, operational, and programmatic capability requirements necessary to support the City's goals for sustainable facility development and long-term management. The City's expectation is that the selected team will assume responsibility for delivering a comprehensive, well-coordinated, and high-quality solution that ensures effective project delivery and ongoing operational excellence.

title: Developer for Blue Heron Nature Preserve Redevelopment
short_description: Developer-operator sought for a new sustainable nature center in Atlanta.
project_scope: Redevelopment of the Blue Heron Nature Preserve through delivery of a new purpose-built nature center. The selected developer/operator team will provide design, financing, construction, and long-term operation. The project emphasizes environmental education, community engagement, natural resource stewardship, sustainable facility development, coordinated delivery, and ongoing operational management. No gross floor area, span, or other technical dimensions are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services, planning/master planning, financing, construction, and long-term operation/management of the nature center.
relevance_explanation:
- Project is primarily a developer/operator procurement rather than a focused structural engineering or specialist design tender.
- Building type is a nature center; no indication of large spans, complex roof structures, bridges, or special structural systems.
- Includes planning and design responsibilities, which creates some indirect entry potential.
- Sustainability and public/community use are positive aspects, but structural ambition is not described.
- Overall only limited fit with sbp's core focus on bridges, long-span roofs, and special structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available cost-related information: redevelopment of Blue Heron Nature Preserve, including a new purpose-built nature center, with design, financing, construction, and long-term operation by the selected team. No realistic USD estimate can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No planning fee or engineering fee is stated. Because the procurement is for a developer/operator team covering design, financing, construction, and operations, no reliable sbp fee estimate can be derived from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Bidders will be evaluated on minimum technical, operational, and programmatic capability requirements necessary to support the City's goals for sustainable facility development and long-term management. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the source.
award_criteria: Evaluation based on whether vendors meet minimum technical, operational, and programmatic capability requirements. No weighting or detailed scoring criteria are stated.
